notes.title: Swords & Souls Legacy Collection comes to Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]The Original SoulGame Collection is here![/h1]

You have been many to ask us for it, I'm very happy to announce that the original [i][b]Swords & Souls[/b][/i] game is coming to Steam! And it's not coming alone, but packed with all 5 SoulGame classic Flash games, including the [b][i]Rogue Soul[/i][/b] series of course, [b][i]The Soul Driver[/i][/b] and [b][i]The Gentleman[/i][/b]. 

[h3]👇[b]Wishlist now[/b]👇 to support us and be notified on launch![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189440/Swords__Souls_Legacy_Collection

[list]
[*] Five full-feature games in one to retrace SoulGame history from 2011 to 2015!
[*] FHD support allowing to play in fullscreen, and for Rogue Soul 1 & 2 and The Soul Driver specifically, borders have been widened to further improve the gameplay experience! 
[*] Better performances on average than the Web versions
[*] An exclusive set of new skins I cooked for Rogue Soul 2
[*] Steam Achievements including the best challenges from all five games 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32336194/c8cf00e8e21f7423e37ee7c0ca192c71a3992cb3.gif[/img]

See you around in game!

[h3][i]Argl & Kuho[/i][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32336194/460a3a81a31a18a4293e93f1ed6f6ae78152e862.png[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE V1.15
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there wonderful Souls,[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32336194/0e4f54280d8e065135dedf60ca8dcdef06a0fd50.gif[/img]

[b]The game is now available on MacOS! [/b]

We also added Steam Cards! Yay! And with the last Steam update they're even extra shiny :) 
We hope you'll have fun collecting cards, badges, backgrounds and emotes. 

Thank you all for your feedback, that helped us improving and fixing some parts of the game. 

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Capped "Increase Stats" mission at 50 maximum
[*] Reduced requirement for Melee combo medal
[*] Reduced max requirement for Combo Star missions from 50 to 40
[*] Reduced home prices step up
[*] Increased fishing perfect tolerance to 375 ms
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed total game time being reset.
[*] Fixed healing negative number
[*] Fixed bug with home price not increasing properly
[*]Switched to 64 bits system, should help avoid crash and hopefully save corruption.
[/list]

Sorry the Steam Cloud is still unavailable, we are facing a super weird issue where only half the save files are sync... x( We'll let you know as soon as we find a fix.

notes.title: UPDATE v1.14
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32336194/bbc8fbb45236feee8f758ef05f23e133731062fa.png[/img]

[b][h1]THANK YOU![/h1][/b]
We want to say how happy we are to see so many of you enjoying the game. It's the best reward for us really!

[h1]CHANGE LOG v1.14[/h1]
 [b]Addition[/b][list]
[*] Options disable/enable screen shake, flashes and text shake
[*] Defense training: mouse will now appear when you lose, so you can easily quit training
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b][list]
[*] Smoother difficulty curve for Shuriken (Melee and Defense)
[*] Increased earning from fishing
[*] Reduced Range training medal combo star requirement
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b][list]
[*] Fixed leader-board not displaying thousands
[*] Fixed Pupset giving you the instructions for Agility training critical too soon
[*] Fixed Ring/Weapon persistent info
[*] Fixed entering training without unlocking it
[*] Fixed negative number
[*] Fixed the achievement beating final boss with beginner set not working without shield
      > Requires full basic armor, one basic melee weapon and both basic range weapons. You can use ring and pets.
[*] Fixed the crinkles in map music
[*] Fixed many typos
[*] Fixed missing translation for Fish trophies
[/list]

[h1]WE ARE WORKING ON[/h1]
[list]
[*] Save deletion issue: we're still investigating, it's a very complex issue for us. Sorry for the inconvenience. 
[*] Cloud save: we know a lot of you are waiting for Cloud Save. It was delayed due to the save issues but we're working on it. Thanks for your patience. 
[*] Steam card for a future update!

Join us: [url=https://twitter.com/soulgameStudio]Twitter[/url] / [url=https://www.facebook.com/soulgame/]Facebook[/url]

Argl & Kuho

notes.title: Development news #2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32336194/a1e4a1e2dc88b9ab84e285be299993adc2deac01.gif[/img]

[h1]Hello Souls![/h1]

First of all, we wanted to thank you for all the nice words on the last news post, we greatly appreciate! 
This month we focused on crafting more content to populate the game world. Here are a few examples to share some of our progress.

[h1]More enemies![/h1]

Meet the kobold and the bat, they are waiting for you in the mines! Each Kobold has a different pattern: the Miner, the Spitter and (obviously), the Boomer! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32336194/9dce36dc721f96ba88b884257b6960d1cedc2007.gif[/img]

Here is a sneak peek at the first two chapters of the game, showcasing the Giant Hills and the Kobold Mines.

[h1]More dialogs![/h1]

Like shown in the first image, we are trying to make the world more alive by adding some NPC factions on which you'll stumble across your journey. The Order is one of those. 

[h1]Video series![/h1]
Finally, here is the first video of a series that we'll post over the next weeks to show you more gameplay.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-Vr3OZV4KOE

That's it for today, we'll continue updating you each month we our progress on the game :) 

Thanks for your continuous support!

Stay in touch with us, on [url=facebook.com/soulgame/]Facebook[/url],[url=twitter.com/soulgameStudio]Twitter[/url], 

[i]Argl & Kuho[/i]

notes.title: Development news!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Souls![/h1]

Hope you are all doing great! We have been very busy making the game shine those last months and would like to share with you some of our progress :) 

[h1]Interface[/h1]

We worked a lot on UI and user experience to make it more cartoon-ish, more consistent, more clear, and extra juicy!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32336194/abe093dbfbddb8db4519eac364a3301993d9a027.gif[/img]

[h1]Map & Story[/h1]

We revamped the story to provide clear goals for the player. We also completely redesigned the map so it now matches the story and provide a clear paths to progress towards, as well as optional paths to explore as you will. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32336194/6a3c99e430b51bb8dbc3d0c51ee4bc38121b1265.png[/img]
[i](Skulls will help you quickly evaluate the difficulty of each stages.)[/i]

[h1]Fishing & Taming[/h1]

Taming and fishing are in, assuming you've bought a fishing rod and a flute that is. We tried to make those new systems simple yet cute and enjoyable, we're eager to see how you feel about them :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32336194/a41eb9627e5a76a91598a637529153793c04a046.png[/img]
[i](Before taming, you'll have to get the proper music sheet!)[/i]

[h1]Training[/h1]

We made sure each unique training features you unlocked via rank up is properly represented throughout the mini game course, which makes for a more balanced and dynamic experience (hopefully!). We also added an exciting new features we hope you'll love: training Melee parry!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32336194/0fcb64a1156872bac807e13becc2b115bb067208.gif[/img]

[h1]Thanks for your support![/h1]
Stay in touch by [url=http://steampowered.com/app/679900]wishlisting the game![/url]

[i]Argl & Kuho[/i]
